items.title: L&T: September quarter results
items.patBasis: attributable to owners of the company
items.mapping: Six source columns extracted by row label and checked against the rendered PDF. First three are comparable quarters. No source value repaired by a model.
notes: PAT is attributable to owners of the company, excluding non-controlling interests.

Derived EBITDA proxy = PBT + general finance-cost row + depreciation row − other income. Finance-service and finance-lease funding costs remain operating expenses. The depreciation row also includes impairment/obsolescence; this proxy is not company-reported EBITDA.

items.title: HDFC Bank: MD & CEO succession
items.reason: The October 27 filing says the outgoing MD & CEO completed his tenure at close of business on October 26.
background: The appointment disclosure describes over three decades across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance.
Past leadership roles named in the filing include ICICI Securities CEO & MD, ICICI Bank Executive Director (2017–2023), and ICICI Prudential Life Insurance MD & CEO.
Education reported in the filing: engineering at IIT Kanpur and management at IIM Bangalore.
items.note: Background is attributed to the bank’s October 1 appointment disclosure, referenced by its October 27 filing. It is not independently verified or scraped from LinkedIn.
